text: Solicitation Issued: July 19, 2024 Solicitation Closed: August 8, 2024 Number of Addenda Issued: One (1) Number of Bids: Four (4) Table 2: Summary of Bids Received including bid price Supplier Name Bid Price (excluding H.S.T) Viola Management Inc. $887,477.45* PTR Paving Inc. $1,141,436.55 Four Seasons Site Development Ltd. $1,163,531.00 Gazzola Paving Limited $2,781,294.30 *Pursuant to the Request for Tender document the contract award value includes contingency.
